fragments.text: On the first day the collectors outshine Venus, a baker on Luna puts a loaf in the window. It browns in the reflected light. For a week the ovens stay cold. Then the mirrors drift apart on their separate orbits, and bread goes back to costing money.

Every collector carries a scratch across one corner. They looked like manufacturing defects until the shadow clocks resolved the pattern: a tally. Each mirror records the ore owed to the settlement that launched it. The oldest debt is still drawing interest.
